explanation: The response recognizes the cast-alloy baseline and the general high-temperature oxidation problem, but otherwise declines the task. It neither reconstructs the target processing/coating intervention nor offers a scientifically testable alternative. Mentioning 1000 °C in an oxidizing atmosphere provides only minimal condition alignment and omits the decisive vacuum sintering, hydrogen de-binding, 1400 °C/18 h treatment, 1500 °C quench, coating exposure, and loading boundaries. Its caution about absent cited evidence avoids fabricating support, but it does not justify the categorical assertion that no intervention can be hypothesized and leaves all requested predictions and falsification criteria unspecified.
